review_description: I cannot speak highly enough of our experience. From first contact with Luke from LPS (he was the only installer who attended our home for the quoting process) through the back and forth of emails from me asking ridiculous questions to the final install and commissioning, nothing was too much trouble.Thank you Luke and the team from LPS.
Came at times said would. Always reachable on phone. Used actual electricians, did good job and were easy to pay with no hassling for money
Everything was excellent. I don't need to say anything else.

Luke and the team from LPS Electrical did a fantastic job installing the solar system on our double storey home despite the difficult access. The whole process, from quoting through to inspection and approval was well handled and seamless.

I planned from the get go for a more premium system, as while it would increase costs, we likely will benefit over the life of the system AND we can afford to help bring down the price of better systems.Of the 3 suppliers given to me, LPS from the start listened to the instructions I gave to Solar quotes. From the start they understood my desire to futureproof the system.The customer service was amazing. The planning was amazing, the installation time was quick and I am very glad I went with LPS

Very responsive to questions and changes of mind.  Amended quote after discussion about needs.Installation  was straightforward.  Came back and sorted an issue with the monitoring appVery happy with service

Luke was the only installer from my shortlist who actually came to my house to speak in person about my solar requirements. LPS don’t just do solar, they are fully qualified electricians. We wanted a bigger and higher quality system than the average household to cater for our current energy needs and future battery/EV upgrades. Luke was very helpful on the options and the design for our house. His team was always on time and friendly. The quote was competitive, noting that we weren’t looking for the cheapest option. We settled on REC Alpha Pure R panels and two 5kW Fronius inverters, basically two systems in one, totalling 10.92 kW. As a bonus, Luke has the REC installers certificate which gets the 25-year warranty. We had some teething issues on the setup, but these were fixed promptly and at no extra cost. I definitely would recommend LPS for your solar install, because you know you have a fully qualified electrician.
Excellent communications, follow up. Solar system offered suited us. Good price quote. Fast and tidy installation after Solar Victoria rebate approved. Grid connection one week later. Very pleased.

All the steps were clearly explained. Able to clearly answer question. Worked cooperatively with the certifier. Set up the wifi. The crew were good humoured, communicated well, tidied up and treated me and my home with respect.
